components.name: Metric card
components.description: Illustrative metric, comparison and sample hierarchy; values are preview content.
components.css: .ds-metric{font-family:Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #131c33);background:var(--surface, #fff);border:1px solid var(--line, #e7e7e2);cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;text-align:left;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 14px;width:260px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-label{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:750}.ds-label svg{color:var(--accent, #1d5ce0)}.ds-metric strong{font-size:1.45rem;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em}.ds-metric small{font-size:.7rem;color:var(--muted, #626b7d);font-weight:600}.ds-context,.ds-sample{font-size:.71rem;line-height:1.4;color:var(--muted, #626b7d)}.ds-sample{border-top:1px solid var(--line-soft, #f0f0ec);padding-top:6px}.ds-metric:hover{border-color:var(--accent, #1d5ce0);background:var(--line-soft, #f0f0ec)}.ds-metric:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1d5ce0);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Chart toggle
components.description: Selected detail mode uses the incumbent blue.

components.name: Measure selector
components.css: .ds-measure{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font: .82rem Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #131c33)}.ds-measure select{font-family:Manrope,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink, #131c33);background:var(--surface, #fff);border:1px solid var(--line, #e7e7e2);cursor:pointer;font:inherit;min-height:36px;max-width:100%;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px}.ds-measure select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent, #1d5ce0);outline-offset:3px}@media(pointer:coarse){.ds-measure select{min-height:44px}}

components.name: Sales navigation
components.description: Shared shell primitive, retained outside feature ownership.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Sales sections"><button>Sales performance</button><button aria-current="page">Efficiency margin</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line, #e7e7e2);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface, #fff)}.ds-nav button{flex:1;min-height:38px;padding:0 14px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted, #626b7d);font:700 .8rem Manrope,system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),color .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#fafaf8;color:var(--ink, #131c33)}.ds-nav button[aria-current=page]{background:var(--accent, #1d5ce0);color:#fff}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #76a7ff;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: Operate keeps the existing navy-and-white Sales workspace and Manrope typography. Shallow metric cards expose the critical value, comparison and sample; selecting a card reveals the calculation and breakdown. This is a feature extension, not a replacement brand.
keyCharacteristics: Compact summaries with explicit units and sample context.
Detailed charts and tables on demand.
Source-aware wording and visible missing-data states.
dos: Do preserve the incumbent Sales palette and Manrope typography.
Do keep period, unit, sample and missing-data context attached to values.
Do keep chart detail paired with a complete table and keyboard dismissal.
donts: Don't infer conversion, profit or import causes from these activity measures.
Don't expand the overview into a wall of full charts.
Don't treat the root standalone design record as a prescription to replace the current Sales shell.
